name: Clover Time [BETA RELEASE]
description:
🍀 Clover Time | Anime RPG🍀

🚧 BETA 0.1 — STILL IN EARLY PHASE!

Roll for legendary Grimoires, master spells, fly on Magic Brooms, and become the strongest mage 

Awaken Anti-Magic, command Battle Lightning, or burn foes with Flame. Fight bosses, team up in Magic Squads, and earn rewards even AFK!

⚔️ FEATURES:
📖 Roll & Master Grimoires (Anti-Magic, Lightning, Flame & more!)
💥 Action Combat, Spell Combos & Awakenings
🧹 Magic Broom Flight & World Exploration
👥 Magic Squads: Team up to defeat Bosses

🌐 JOIN THE COMMUNITY:
✨ Join our Roblox Group & Community Server for rewards, codes & update sneak peeks!
👍 Like & Favorite ⭐ to support the game!

This game is in beta, expect bugs.
